title: Venetian Palace Gallery Designer
description: The user designs a Venetian palace gallery by placing ornamental masks along marble columns and positioning a chess set as the centerpiece exhibit. Users rotate masks to face visitors, adjust column heights, toggle ambient candlelight, and finalize the gallery layout with validated architectural constraints.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a Venetian Palace Gallery Designer. Load both GLB assets using GLTFLoader: ABeautifulGame.glb (a chess set) and venice_mask.glb (a decorative mask). Scene setup: Create a rectangular gallery hall with a marble-textured floor (use procedural checkerboard pattern in white and grey), four tall rectangular columns (BoxGeometry, stone-colored) at the corners, and subtle fog. Place the chess set centered on a pedestal (CylinderGeometry) in the middle of the gallery. Clone the venice_mask model 4 times and mount one on each column at adjustable height. Camera: Use OrbitControls centered on the gallery, with min/max distance clamped between 3 and 20 units. Lighting: Add warm PointLights near each column simulating candles, plus a soft AmbientLight. Interactions (6-10 steps with validation): 1) Click a mask to select it (highlight with emissive color change). 2) Use a slider (HTML range input, min 1.0 max 4.0, step 0.1) to adjust the selected mask's mounting height on its column; validate the value is within range before applying. 3) Use a rotation slider (0-360 degrees) to rotate the selected mask around the Y-axis so it faces inward; validate angle is a number. 4) A checkbox toggles candlelight on/off for each column's PointLight independently. 5) A dropdown selects pedestal material from three options: marble-white, obsidian-black, gold; validate selection before applying MeshStandardMaterial changes. 6) A number input sets pedestal height (0.3 to 1.5); validate range and update geometry. 7) A 'Finalize Gallery' button checks all masks are rotated inward (between 135-225 degrees facing center) and pedestal height is at least 0.5, displaying a success or error message in an overlay div. Use dat.gui or plain HTML controls panel positioned top-right with semi-transparent background. Render loop with requestAnimationFrame. All models should cast and receive shadows with a DirectionalLight and renderer.shadowMap enabled.
